title: Aquitect
summary: Raise an island from an open sea and build a city where every neighbour counts. Grow from windmills to fusion, then climb down from the sky to drive, sail, dive and fly through the city you built, defend it from pirates, and watch the tide rise over it. No fail state, no microtransactions.
about:
Raise an island from the sea

Every city starts with an empty ocean. Buy land plot by plot and shape your own coastline: a sheltered bay, a long trading shore, or a scatter of green islets. The sea runs on in every direction, so your island can be a straight line, a ring around a lagoon, or any shape you can draw with land. The island is yours before the first house is.

Every neighbor counts

Placement is the game. Seventy-five adjacency rules read the grid: a Bakery beside a Water Tower earns more, a Market undercuts the corner shop, a Wind Mill hates houses in its wind. Parks and hospitals lift the streets around them; factories and coal plants poison them, and a Sky Garden parked beside a polluter cleans its air. Drag a building and the game tells you what it gets and what it gives before you commit.

Four eras, one city

Grow from a farm to a town, a city and a technological hub. Each tier brings new buildings and a new problem: power early on, happiness and pollution at Tier 3, research at Tier 4. A quest chain of fifty-four steps teaches each mechanic the moment the economy introduces it. Or skip the story entirely: Free build starts you with a little gold, no quests, and the whole sea to yourself.

Then climb down

At any moment, leave the planner's sky. Drive a delivery from the farm to the store, sail the catch to the marina, fly supplies to the hospital roof. Upgrade the Garage and unlock eight cars, from the farm ute to the stretch limo. When a pirate skiff anchors off your modern coast, take the boat out and hose it off with the water cannon; when a thief hits a shop, ram him, or let the police you built do it.

The Rising Tide

Late in the game, build a Submarine Lab and the sea starts to rise. Every ten minutes the water comes in over the whole island, and for three minutes your city keeps running under shield domes while research triples. Take the submarine out, collect the samples drifting between the towers, and watch the fish swim over the rooftops. It is opt-in, it never costs you gold, and it is the strangest, calmest three minutes in the game.

Watch it all grow back

Every plot and every placement is recorded. Whenever you like, replay your city's whole life: empty ocean to glowing metropolis in under a minute, the camera orbiting as the numbers climb. Built for sharing.

Numbers, if you want them

A full City Statistics overlay for the players who like to know why: income history, a ledger of every coin, an income waterfall from base output through adjacency, efficiency and happiness, and an Improve tab that ranks the best building for each empty plot and flies the camera to it.

A premium, peaceful toy

Vibrant low-poly art, a calm soundtrack, no fail state, no wait timers, no microtransactions. Walk away for a day and come back to a city that is fine. A first run to the landmark takes a little over two hours; then prestige, keep your bonuses, and build again on a fresh sea.

Features

• 
Raise your island plot by plot on an open sea; the coastline is a design decision
• 
Seventy-five adjacency rules, happiness, pollution and efficiency auras: placement is the puzzle
• 
Four tiers from windmills to fusion, with a fifty-four-quest story or Free build
• 
Five ways to see your city: god view, car, boat, submarine and helicopter, with deliveries by car, boat and helicopter
• 
Pirates, thieves, a water cannon and a police force
• 
The Rising Tide: an opt-in late-game event under shield domes
• 
Prestige landmarks and a new-game-plus loop that respects your time
• 
Replay any city as a timelapse; City Statistics for the curious
• 
English and Greek; no microtransactions, no wait timers
